Definition: from G4732; something established, i.e. (abstractly) confirmation (stability):--stedfastness.
BiblicalUsage: The word is steadfastness itself, the firm order of a church. Paul rejoices beholding the order and the stedfastness of the Colossians' faith in Christ, though he is absent in the flesh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe order and steadfastness go together: a church that stands firm is a church in good order.
